sequence_description: I1 proof-integrity: ensure Dex rejects a SAMLResponse whose Destination does not match the configured redirectURI/ACS (prevents signature-valid but semantically redirected proof). Includes control valid SAML login then mutated Destination attempt.
description: [LLM-Judge] Both the control and attacker SAML logins returned HTTP 200/success, but the subsequent identity verification failed with "Invalid bearer token", suggesting the OIDC token issuance/session binding did not complete as expected (test cannot confirm Destination-mismatch rejection).

sequence_description: Attempt an expired SAML assertion twice (same Assertion/@ID) after a successful control login, to detect acceptance of expired proofs and/or replay of expired artifacts.
description: [LLM-Judge] SAML login endpoints returned HTTP 200/success for an explicitly expired assertion (and its replay), but subsequent identity verification failed with 'Invalid bearer token', suggesting the SAML response may be accepted at the ACS layer without producing a valid session/token.
